A1.justification: Both PDFs describe VisRet and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–D. Content can be matched reliably despite repagination and two omitted qualitative examples.

before.justification: v3 reports original retrieval and downstream VQA results, model comparisons, aggregation ablations and qualitative analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains original retrieval and VQA results, including Table 2, Figure 2 and the experiments in Appendix C.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same LLM-generated visualization instructions, image generation, within-image retrieval and reciprocal rank fusion. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Visual-RAG, Visual-RAG-ME, INQUIRE-Rerank-Hard and COCO-Hard with the same retrieval/VQA coverage. Removing two displayed examples from Table 10 does not establish a change to the evaluated datasets.

E2.justification: Tables 2 and 9 retain the same original-query, LLM rewriting, BLIP corpus captioning, VISA reranking and captioning reranking baselines. The downstream VQA comparator sets also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The stated data filtering, sample counts, Recall/nDCG metrics, retrieval depths, model configurations and VQA evaluation procedures in Section 5.1 and Appendices A–C are unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix D/Table 10 removes two qualitative success cases: a hummingbird in flight and a bathroom scene. The module comparisons, aggregation ablation, generated-image-as-knowledge study and failure analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: The sampling description and single- versus three-image analysis in Section 6.2 are unchanged. Neither version reports confidence intervals or significance tests, and v4 adds no seed or repeated-run information.

E6.justification: v4 omits two Table 10 result entries. In v3, the hummingbird case has baseline/VisRet ranks 60/7 and the bathroom case 54/4; both report baseline/VisRet nDCG@10 of 0.00/0.39. Retained numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3's retrieval and VQA formulations and reciprocal rank fusion equation are identical. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about query visualization, within-modality retrieval, Visual-RAG-ME and retrieval/VQA benefits.

C2.justification: The explanations of caption information loss, generator dependence, retrieval failures and limitations of generated images as VQA evidence remain unchanged, as do the ethical caveats.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same prompts, model versions, temperature, image-quality setting, RRF parameter and A100 hardware disclosure. Code/data access information and licensing statements are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography contain the same cited works and research positioning. Reference text is repaginated without substantive revision.

P1.justification: The first two authors change order from Yixin Wan, Di Wu to Di Wu, Yixin Wan, with equal contribution retained. The prose, section hierarchy and narrative are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 5 and Figure 5 are enlarged. Table 10 loses two example rows and appears before Figures 6–8 instead of after them. Float spacing and pagination change, and printed page numbers disappear; retained visual content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: Enlarging Table 5 and Figure 5 improves their legibility, while removing two Table 10 success cases slightly reduces illustrative breadth. The remaining examples still cover all four benchmarks, and the method, aggregate results, substantive analyses and reproducibility information are unchanged. These limited presentation tradeoffs do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
